meta.title: Melia Danang Beach Resort Review 🌴 | 5-Star Family Resort Worth The Money?
meta.description:
Is Melia Danang Beach Resort really worth the money for families? 🌴

In this vlog, we share our full experience staying at this 5-star resort in Da Nang, Vietnam and why it might be one of the best choices for families traveling with kids.

The biggest win for us? The kids were constantly entertained, which took so much pressure off as parents. From the kids club to the pools and beach access, there was always something for them to do. That meant we could actually relax and enjoy the resort too.

We also break down the value for money and whether this luxury resort is worth it compared to other family-friendly hotels in Da Nang.

What we cover:
Kids club & children’s activities
Swimming pools & beachfront access
Family-friendly facilities
Food & dining options
Overall experience & value for money

If you're planning a family trip to Da Nang and want a stress-free stay where both kids AND parents are happy, this resort is definitely worth considering.
